verdict.rationale: Discord's own blog documents Threads, including private threads, as a way to branch a conversation off a channel's main feed. That lets admins organize some discussions under named threads. But threads are optional side-branches of an unstructured main feed, so the evidence does not show that every conversation is organized by topic, and nothing documents catch-up tools for busy channels. missing for 10: evidence that threading is enforced or the default for all conversations (e.g. topic-required channels), catch-up features such as unread or thread summaries, and independent hands-on corroboration that threads make busy channels efficient to follow.
